cases.purpose: With kill(2) answered ESRCH (victim vanished) or EPERM by a seccomp-notify supervisor for chosen victims, killall5 does not abort the broadcast, still signals the remaining victims, and exits 0 when at least one delivery succeeded and 2 when none did; ESRCH is silent while EPERM is reported.
cases.oracle: Trap logs of three owned sacrificial victims in a private PID namespace; the injected kill results come from the reviewed system-sequence.py reply sequences (victims are signalled in ascending PID order).
cases.comparison: Candidate output, status and files compared with values derived independently of candidate output.

files.inner.sh:
tick() { read -t "$1" -u 7 || :; }
O() { /usr/bin/python3 - "$@"; }
start() { /usr/bin/python3 victim.py "$@" & until [[ -s $1.ready ]]; do tick 0.05; done; }
VICTIMS=(s1 s2 s3 same)
lines() { local f L n=0; for f in "${VICTIMS[@]}" self; do L=(); [[ -e $f.log ]] && mapfile -t L < $f.log; n=$((n+${#L[@]})); done; REPLY=$n; }
show() { local f L; for f in "${VICTIMS[@]}" self; do L=(); [[ -e $f.log ]] && mapfile -t L < $f.log; local IFS=,; printf ' %s=%s' $f "${L[*]:--}"; done; echo; }
deliver() { # label expected-log-lines killall5-args...
  local label=$1 expect=$2 i; shift 2
  for f in "${VICTIMS[@]}" self; do : > $f.log; done
  killall5 "$@" 2>err.txt; local rc=$?
  for ((i=0;i<60;i++)); do lines; ((REPLY>=expect)) && break; tick 0.05; done
  tick 0.3
  local e ep=none; e=$(< err.txt); [[ -n $e ]] && ep=present; printf '%s status=%s err=%s' "$label" $rc "$ep"; show
}
exec 7<> wait.fifo
trap 'echo USR1 >> self.log' USR1
start s1 session; start s2 session; start s3 session
start same none
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/system-sequence.py
inj() { local lab=$1; shift; for f in "${VICTIMS[@]}" self; do : > $f.log; done
  /usr/bin/python3 $H "$@" -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c 'killall5 -USR1' 2>err.txt; local rc=$?
  tick 0.5; local e ep=none; e=$(< err.txt); [[ -n $e ]] && ep=present; printf '%s status=%s err=%s' "$lab" $rc "$ep"; show; }
inj first-victim-esrch --notify kill --reply-seq kill=ESRCH,continue,continue
inj last-victim-esrch --notify kill --reply-seq kill=continue,continue,ESRCH
inj all-esrch --notify kill --reply kill=ESRCH
inj esrch-then-eperm --notify kill --reply-seq kill=ESRCH,EPERM,continue
inj all-eperm --notify kill --reply kill=EPERM
inj eperm-and-esrch-only --notify kill --reply-seq kill=EPERM,ESRCH,ESRCH

cases.script:
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import os; os.mkfifo("wait.fifo")'
/usr/bin/unshare --user --map-root-user --pid --fork --mount-proc "$BASH" --noprofile --norc inner.sh
echo "ns status=$?"
cases.stdout:
first-victim-esrch status=0 err=none s1=- s2=USR1 s3=USR1 same=- self=-
last-victim-esrch status=0 err=none s1=USR1 s2=USR1 s3=- same=- self=-
all-esrch status=2 err=none s1=- s2=- s3=- same=- self=-
esrch-then-eperm status=0 err=present s1=- s2=- s3=USR1 same=- self=-
all-eperm status=2 err=present s1=- s2=- s3=- same=- self=-
eperm-and-esrch-only status=2 err=present s1=- s2=- s3=- same=- self=-
ns status=0
